(1) the prevalence of peritoneal endo­ metriosis is higher in women with PCOS than in control women, and (2) women with PCOS have a higher risk of developing peritoneal end­ometriosis than control women.
the expression of Epo and its receptor, EpoR, is significantly upregulated in endometriotic tissues.
the expression of erythropoiesin and the erythropoietic receptor are increased in the peritoneal fluid of women with endometriosis, and this is related to the degree of inflammation.

the development and characterization of a novel, non-invasive method of assessing the degree of endometriosis in patients with endometriosis-associated infertility.
the development of a novel approach to the design of new and more effective drugs to treat endometriosis and other diseases of the female reproductive system.

the endometrioma is a complex disease with a variety of pathophysiological pathways that are involved.
